data.title: Build Amazing Simple Molecules!
data.description: Snap atoms together like building blocks to discover how water, oxygen, and carbon dioxide are made!

targetMolecule.name: Water
targetMolecule.realWorldUse: Water covers 71% of Earth and is essential for all living things!
targetMolecule.imagePrompt: A crystal clear droplet of water resting on a vibrant green leaf, reflecting sunlight in a lush forest.

challenges.instruction: Let's start simple! Snap together two Hydrogen atoms and one Oxygen atom to build water (H2O).
challenges.hint: Connect each Hydrogen atom with a single bond to the central Oxygen atom.
challenges.narration: Amazing! You built water — H2O! Every raindrop, every ocean wave is made of this life-giving molecule!

challenges.instruction: Now let's build the oxygen gas we breathe! Snap together two Oxygen atoms to make O2.
challenges.hint: Oxygen atoms like to share four electrons, creating a double bond between them.
challenges.narration: Fantastic job! You built O2, the oxygen gas that fills our atmosphere and helps us breathe every day!

challenges.instruction: Time for Carbon Dioxide! Combine one Carbon atom and two Oxygen atoms to make CO2.
challenges.hint: Put Carbon in the middle and use double bonds to connect it to both Oxygen atoms.
challenges.narration: Incredible! CO2 is exhaled by animals and used by plants to make food through photosynthesis!

challenges.instruction: You are a master molecule builder! Use the atom palette to create any molecule you can imagine.
challenges.hint: Make sure every atom's valence bonds are fully connected with green indicators!
challenges.narration: You are thinking like a real chemist, exploring how different building blocks connect in our universe!
